title: HET update: instant news, JAMB practice and Premium
content: Welcome to Highly Exceptional Tutorial! Study with notes and practice questions for JAMB, WAEC and NECO, take the JAMB simulator, bookmark questions, and join the student discussion. Free users get 5 practice questions per subject and a 15-minute simulator. Premium unlocks the full question bank. You will now receive news like this instantly, so keep notifications turned on.
